description: Cliffside (100x50): a wide level-4 plain west of the start between sea cliffs and highland terraces; the Nuclear Reactor stands on flat ground in the middle of that plain beside the river, one Deep Ore Vein with its Deep Mine at the plain's west end and the other on the level-8 bench east of the river, a Deep Drill and the sandstone quarry on the plain, the Deep Processor on the level-14 highland, the second Deep Ore Source with its drill on the north-east level-2 terrace, and five Human Record Caches around two Archive Excavations; the only fishable bay has banks too high above its water until a dam raises it.
